title: 👋 자기소개 (Self Introduction)
description: Learn how to introduce yourself and state your nationality in Korean.

title: ☕ 카페에서 주문하기 (Cafe Ordering)
description: Learn basic expressions for ordering coffee and asking for the price.

title: 🗺️ 길 찾기 (Asking for Directions)
description: Practice intermediate phrases for asking directions to the subway station.

title: 🍱 한국의 식사 예절 (Dining Etiquette)
description: Advanced discussion about traditional Korean dining manners and culture.

title: 🏪 편의점에서 물건 사기 (Convenience Store)
description: Basic phrases for buying snacks and using a plastic bag at a convenience store.

title: 📅 나의 하루 일정 (Daily Routines)
description: Simple sentences to describe your daily schedule and activities.

title: 🏥 병원에서 증상 말하기 (At the Hospital)
description: Intermediate level conversation for explaining symptoms and receiving a prescription.

title: 🛍️ 옷 쇼핑하기 (Shopping for Clothes)
description: Useful expressions for asking about sizes, colors, and trying on clothes.

title: 🥢 전통 시장 탐방 (Traditional Market)
description: Advanced vocabulary for exploring traditional markets and bargaining.

title: 💼 한국의 직장 생활 (Business Meeting)
description: Advanced business Korean for meetings and professional interactions.
